You will work in Ninove, in a modern and highly automated environment specialized in logistics automation and automated warehouse systems.

The company develops, integrates and maintains automation solutions that help warehouses, production environments and distribution centers operate more efficiently.

Jobomschrijving

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.

Your responsibilities:

• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.
• Ensuring that automated warehouse installations operate safely and efficiently.
• Carrying out technical interventions independently and identifying the root cause of malfunctions.
• Recording maintenance activities and interventions correctly in the CMMS system (Sprocket).
• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations.

• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.
• Good physical fitness.
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts

Industry- automation systems warehouse

Jobomschrijving

For a company that designs, integrates, and maintains logistics automation solutions to optimize internal logistics processes in warehouses, production, and distribution

Your Responsibilities:

• Maintenance, repair, and installation of complex warehouse automation systems.
• Ensure smooth operation of our installations by performing timely maintenance and resolving technical issues quickly and efficiently.
• Analyze malfunctions and resolve them independently, with an eye for safety and customer satisfaction.
• Work mostly independently, but be a team player when necessary.
• Report your interventions in our system to ensure and improve quality.

• Diploma in electromechanics, electricity, and/or mechanics.
• Basic knowledge of automation is a plus, such as knowledge of SCADA, use of multimeters.
• Several years of experience in a technical role is a plus.
• Work independently, accurately, and customer-oriented.
• Fluent communication in Dutch and/or English.
• No fear of heights; our work takes place at different levels.
• Good physical condition for physical work.
• Flexible and willing to work occasionally outside standard hours.
• Motivated, responsible, and keep administration tidy.
• Eager to learn and share a passion for technology.
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, PLC control systems; if this appeals to you, this job is for you.
• All-round PC skills and experience with CMMS systems, (Sprocket).
• “You are open to working weekends.

At its Ghent facility, Legend Biotech focuses on the manufacturing of advanced CAR-T cell therapies for the treatment of multiple myeloma.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have a Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences and experience with cell culture? Would you like to contribute to groundbreaking therapies that are changing patients' lives worldwide?

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

For our client, a biotech company that is a fast-growing & innovative organization, we are looking for a warehouse associate.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 

Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, …) in a controlled temperature environment.

Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies.

Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic

Fill out the Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for incoming materials including: transport unloading, temperature control, integrity control, administrative paperwork related to following correct procedures.

Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment.

Work closely together with the Operations and Quality department to support the Production and Lab activities for our start-up site.  

Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes.

Working in two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to process inbound, picking and outbound activities.

Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts.

At Legend Biotech in Zwijnaarde, you will have the opportunity to participate in the production of advanced CAR-T cell therapies, an innovative form of cancer treatment. You will work in a highly technological GMP-regulated environment.

• Working daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment
• Ensuring the cleanliness of equipment and production areas
Performing various steps within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including:

• Cell isolation
• Cell selection, activation, and transduction
• Cell culture
• Aseptic processing
• Filling and finishing operations
• Cryopreservation
Manufacturing clinical and commercial ATMPs (Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products)

• Adhering to all applicable quality and safety standards
Performing in-process controls on batch samples while maintaining the highest quality standards

Strictly following SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), batch records, and GMP guidelines

• Recording and managing GMP documentation to ensure compliance and traceability
Supporting environmental monitoring and the maintenance of GMP production areas

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Who are you?

You are a detail-oriented team player who enjoys working in an innovative manufacturing environment.

You have:

• A Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, or an equivalent field
• Initial experience with cell culture
• Experience in a GMP environment and/or ATMP manufacturing is a strong asset
• Good command of English, both written and spoken
• Willingness to work in a shift-based system
• A hands-on mentality and strong attention to detail

jobs.occupation: Power Electronics and Motor Control Engineer
jobs.description:
Welcome to Traxial (A Magnax Company): Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we are designing the next generation of high-performance, energy-efficient systems. We're looking for a PE & Motor Control Engineer to join our innovative team and play a pivotal role in creating systems that push boundaries in robotics and industry.
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design, develop, and optimize high-efficiency power electronic & motor control systems.
   
 

•  

Create detailed requirements and functional designs for power electronic circuits & motor controllers..
   
 

•  

Perform simulations, testing, and validation to ensure system performance meets all requirements.
   
 

•  

Troubleshoot and resolve issues during the design, prototyping, and manufacturing phases.
   
 

•  

Ensure products are compliant with relevant standards for power drive systems.
   
 

•  

Stay informed about the latest trends and developments in power electronics in robotics & industrial applications.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

A Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Minimum of 3 years of experience in power electronics & circuit design.
   
 

•  

Strong knowledge of inverters and motor controllers.
   
 

•  

Experience with PCB design tools such as Kicad, Altium or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Experience with electronic circuit simulation software such as LTSpice or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Understanding of thermal management and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC).
   
 

•  

Previous experience in model-based design and/or FPGA platforms will be considered a plus.
   
 

•  

A team player with excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.
   
 

•  

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
